text.description_html:
McKinney 451 Double Acting Door Spring

This economical series of door springs is designed to be surface applied to the door and frame. It is a simplified method of closing double acting doors (doors that swing both directions) that doesn't require special knowledge or tools. Adjustable tension allow you to determine how much closing force you apply (how hard/fast the door self closes) with no special adjustment tools required. Available in 9", 11", and 13" overall lengths.

Includes (6) #12 x 1" color matched wood screws for installation.

Specifications: for McKinney Double Acting Door Spring

  • Spring Material: Steel Wire
  • Brackets: Wrought Steel
  • Finish Color: Black Powder Coat
  • Double Acting
  • Adjustable Spring Tension
  • Includes #12 x 1" Wood Screws

Available in 3 Sizes:

    MCK-451:
    • Overall Length: 9"
    • Spring Length: 5"

    MCK-452:
    • Overall Length: 11"
    • Spring Length: 7"

    MCK-453:
    • Overall Length: 13"
    • Spring Length: 9"

    Sold Individually
